provenance.procedure: GET /search/movie?query=test&page=1 with an Authorization: Bearer <v4 read access token>; synthesised from the published TMDB v3 /search/movie contract (ADR-0026) because CI has no token and none may be committed. Regenerate against a real token with scripts/capture-fixtures.sh tmdb search-movie.
provenance.note: Synthesised: TMDB v3 /search/movie returns hits under a flat results array, shaped like /search/tv but with title (not name) and release_date (not first_air_date). The client reads only id (a NUMBER), title, release_date ("YYYY-MM-DD", sometimes empty) and overview, tolerating the many other fields. The second hit deliberately carries no id, to prove the client skips a hit it could not turn into a want rather than surfacing an unreferenceable row.

response.body: {"page":1,"results":[{"id":500,"title":"A Test Movie","release_date":"2021-06-11","overview":"A movie used to exercise discovery.","popularity":9.4},{"title":"A Movie Without An Id","release_date":"2000-01-01"}],"total_pages":1,"total_results":2}
